Name: Raccoon Pet
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=3]Adds the raccoon as an animal you can select when creating a new save + as an adoptable option at Marnie's once you unlock that! [/size]

[size=5][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[size=3]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- Install the mod (manual download is recommended over Vortex)
- Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
- Launch the game and enjoy! ﻿[/size][size=2]
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=5][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size][size=2]

[/size][size=3]Compatible with everything since it adds the raccoon as its own pet type! Will [b]NOT[/b] work on Stardew Valley 1.5.6.[/size][size=2]

[size=2]
[/size][size=3]You can check out the rest of my mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/95265773]HERE[/url].[/size]
[/size]

Downloads.Description: Fixed the raccoon not being able to walk around.
